annotations.title: Which of these YouTube channels gets more views, and from what?

description: Use when the user is a creator or brand-partnership lead comparing channels: "how does my channel stack up against these three?", "who posts more Shorts and does it pay?", "which creator should we sponsor?". Returns, for each channel over the window, uploads per week, share of Shorts, median views for long-form and Shorts, median views per day, likes and comments per 1,000 views, and optionally how titles with your words perform. Public counts only; results cannot be published. Refuses before you are charged if a channel does not resolve. Every result carries a run id, a date and a citation line. Calling this tool returns a quote, not the result: what the run measures, its price and a payment_url. The run happens only when you POST to payment_url, and a run that fails its controls refuses there with nothing charged. Dimensions (vary these inputs to cut the answer; each call is its own run): over time: one window of days; compare: channels (2-5); segment: format (Shorts, long-form); terms. Price: $0.05 per run over x402 (USDC on Base, no account needed), or $0.50 over MPP (a Stripe shared payment token); charged only when the run comes back sound. For which topics on a subject get views across all channels, use run_topic_views.
